title: Extending the Euler-Heisenberg action to include effects of local Lorentz-symmetry violating backgrounds
summary: This work sets out to compute the corrections to the Euler-Heisenberg effective action that arise from spacetime-dependent background anisotropies that violate Lorentz symmetry. To accomplish our task, we evaluate the functional determinant of the modified Dirac operator using the spectral regularization method. Within the framework of the Standard Model Extension (SME), these Lorentz-violating parameters correspond to the coefficients $m_5(x)$, $a_μ(x)$, and $b_μ(x)$.
